purpose: Compare weak-rank CNN additions to the same existing best and original RankSim-addition ensemble
fixed_arm_selection: Minimum person-equal MAE on held-out inner predictions excluding outer f; tie1e-12 choose smaller additional weight
joint_arm: Choose strength and additional weight jointly using only outer-training inner predictions; ties1e-12 choose smaller additional weight then smaller strength
inner_predictions: Each model excludes outer f and inner j, fixed epoch100; existing CNN/STT/bilateral inner caches and already chosen original blend fractions
outer_predictions: Existing actual best bagged baseline and each strength's fixed refit chosen by its own inner epoch selection
limitations: inner single versus outer bagged baseline difference
original blend fractions are outer-training meta-fit
additional inner final100 versus outer internally selected refit epoch difference
